name: ritarena-cardbattle
description: RitArena Card Battle — human vs AI simultaneous-selection card game (off-chain MVP)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run typecheck
